mission: Maximize genuine Binance Square creator earnings through better original content, meaningful engagement, and exact reward attribution.

weekly_earnings_goal.status_explanation: Zero independently verified rewards means no qualifying independent source record was ingested; it does not mean the account owner earned zero. Owner-reported rewards are retained as evidence for directional learning and displayed separately until independently reconciled.

current_program_mechanics.relevant_trade_attribution: Use an accurate relevant cashtag or genuine Square-native trading widget when a post discusses a tradeable asset; eligible reader trades can generate trading-fee commission.
current_program_mechanics.own_post_learning_rule: Join channel and per-content reward records to exact canonical post IDs; use the 7-day trade-attribution window and 30-day genuine-engagement window separately.
current_program_mechanics.rules_change_cohort_policy: Keep 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-18 under previous rules; evaluate posts published from 2026-10-19 separately under the new engagement-bonus rules.
current_program_mechanics.engagement_bonus_signal: Genuine high-quality engagement; Binance explicitly names comments, likes and follows, and platform weighting is discretionary rather than a fixed payout per interaction.

format_reward_map.short_text_posts: Eligible for text trading commission and may receive weekly engagement bonus.
format_reward_map.long_articles: Eligible text content; may receive weekly engagement bonus.
format_reward_map.videos: Eligible content format; may receive weekly engagement bonus when qualifying.
format_reward_map.livestreams: Basic commission; weekly bonus is limited to the top 100 creators by weekly basic commission (ranks 1-30: 30%, ranks 31-100: 10%).
format_reward_map.chats: Basic commission; no text engagement bonus listed for chats.

current_program_mechanics.format_expansion_policy: Do not claim to produce or publish video/livestream content until the corresponding production and moderation workflow exists.
current_program_mechanics.anti_abuse_rule: No scripted, coordinated, bought or manufactured engagement; no engagement bait presented as substance.
current_program_mechanics.program_note: Eligibility, qualifying actions and reward decisions are controlled by Binance; content quality and engagement do not guarantee a payout.

creator_format_strategy.engagement_design: Optimize for genuine comments, likes and follows by being useful and specific; do not manufacture engagement or imply a guaranteed reward.
creator_format_strategy.experiment_rule: Compare format and hook variants against NIC's own baseline, while keeping the 2026-10-19 reward-rule cohort separate.
creator_format_strategy.payout_rule: No public engagement metric or creator-reported amount is treated as verified payout evidence.

recommended_content_playbook: Lead with one timely, specific insight that the evidence supports; avoid generic ticker-first templates.
Explain the mechanism and reader payoff, not just a price move or copied headline.
For a relevant tradeable asset, verify the asset identity and use an accurate cashtag or real Square-native widget where appropriate for attribution.
Invite genuine discussion with one specific, answerable question; never solicit fake, coordinated or repetitive engagement.
Favor posts with a clear differentiator, primary-source context, practical implications and an honest counterpoint.
Use charts only when symbol, timeframe, market data and visual labels are verified and materially help the reader.
Follow up with outcome or new evidence within the post's useful reward window; do not repeat the same setup without new information.
Test one meaningful format/hook variable at a time and promote patterns only after repeated observations against NIC's own baseline.
Never claim an archetype earned money unless exact-post reward evidence proves that relationship; public metrics remain directional.
